snippet.title: Ravenous Horde - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Check it out: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2179490/Ravenous_Horde?utm_source=youtube_trailer

Team up with 64 players to fight off the horde of zombies in this post-apocalyptic FPS. Getting yourself killed is not the end, but a new beginning as a zombie! Turn on your teammates and tear them apart. Level up and unlock new weapons, perks, clothing options and more!
